dataset.description: Specify which dataset to generate. It can be one of `features`, `masks`, or `target`.

timePeriod.description:
This field is used to define whether to generate plots for the training period or for the validation period. If set to
`training`, data is generated for the training period, as stored in
{@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun#trainFeatureTimeRanges}. If set to `validation`, data is generated
for the validation time ranges instead, stored in {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun#valFeatureTimeRanges} .

timeRange.description:
Use this field to specify a custom time range for which to generate data. If specified, it will override the `timePeriod`
field. One of `timePeriod` or `timeRange` must be specified.

masksToUse.description:
Use this field to specify masks to be applied for computing data. If this field is not specified, all the masks will be
generated by default.

The masks available to plot are:
```
mask_IsAssetNotOperational,
maskAssetEvent,
mask_PreAssetEvent,
mask_PostAssetEvent,
mask_AdHocTraining,
mask_AdHocInference,
mask_AlgorithmicallyComputed
```

title: This spec is used to configure how to generate data using the {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun#computeData} API.
name: ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRunComputeDataSpec
